title: SRD 5.1 importer: exact creature name-set coverage validation
description: The creature coverage check added in loreweaver-0m9.5.1 currently uses a minimum-count floor (MIN_EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_CREATURES) plus an empty-result guard, because enumerating the full SRD 5.1 Monsters-chapter name set by hand (without the vendored PDF) is error-prone. Once the SRD 5.1 PDF is vendored and a full-PDF coverage pass exists, replace the min-count floor with validation against the exact expected creature name set so the importer fails closed on any specific missing/renamed creature, not just gross truncation. NPC stat blocks (the separate 'Nonplayer Characters' section) are intentionally out of scope for the creature kind unless a decision record says otherwise.
notes: PR #141 open for review (branch feat/srd-exact-creature-coverage-0m9.5.14). Not yet merged — close on merge.
